headline: This week: Tara's next steps, building our own customer app, and more demand history for planning

items.title: Demand history: Gurgaon B2C orders from October 2025
items.detail: Orders from the old Gurgaon B2C warehouse (used until May 2026) now count as consumer demand, so planning sees Gurgaon demand for January to May too.

explain.simple: Months of Gurgaon online orders were not being counted in the demand numbers; now they are.
explain.technical: dbt var ops_b2c_sale_order_facilities + GUR_20_2 (facility name GUR_B2C, already mapped to Gurgaon); about 880k order items, Oct 2025 to May 2026. PR #47, live 23 Nov.

upcoming.title: Tara: next steps
upcoming.detail: Getting the new project ready to go live.

explain.simple: Finishing touches on the new project. Details at launch.
explain.technical: Final checks and hosting on AWS.

upcoming.title: Own Troovy customer app
upcoming.detail: Next: connect the screens to our Shopify store, then the store side of the app, then testing and the store listing switch.

explain.simple: Turning the clickable app into a real shopping app on our own store.
explain.technical: Shopify Storefront API (Headless channel), app database for points and check-ins, EAS builds; listing transfer after our Apple/Google accounts are ready.

upcoming.title: Secondary sales automation by Sajid: review and go-live
upcoming.detail: The Blinkit GRN data is live; Sajid's data models on top of it get reviewed and released next.

explain.simple: Checking Sajid's next part together and putting it live.
explain.technical: dbt models (Blinkit PO lines, SKU-level PO lifecycle and journey) via a troovy-analytics PR, reviewed before release.

upcoming.title: Budget tracker: Finance's answers, then the build plan
upcoming.detail: Once Finance answers the questions, the features and the way to build it get finalised.

explain.simple: Finance tells us what they need, and then we decide exactly what to build.
explain.technical: Lock the v1 feature list and the build option (recommended: Apps Script web app on a Finance-owned Google Sheet).

upcoming.title: TrooVault: go-live
upcoming.detail: Security updates are done; remaining: security settings and hosting so the team can use it.

explain.simple: Final checks before the costing app is opened to the team.
explain.technical: Security headers, rate limits on login and unlock, longer passphrases; then hosting on AWS.

upcoming.title: Lighter load on the database
upcoming.detail: Fewer unchanged rows rewritten on each refresh, so the database does less work and backups cost less.

explain.simple: Only save what actually changed, instead of rewriting everything every time.
explain.technical: Skip-unchanged guards in dbt merges, inventory and sheet tables loaded only when changed, incremental ops report orders.

upcoming.title: Calls next to chats in the complaints dashboard
upcoming.detail: Now that Ozonetel calls arrive, show calls and chats together in one complaints view.

explain.simple: One place to see every customer complaint, whether it came by chat or by phone.
explain.technical: Add an Ozonetel calls block to the complaints card, same columns as the KwikEngage tickets.

upcoming.title: Demand dashboard: lost sales, forecast accuracy, KPI tiles
upcoming.detail: The next cards on the planning dashboard after Plan vs Stock.

explain.simple: New cards that show sales missed because of stock-outs, how close past forecasts were, and headline numbers at a glance.
explain.technical: Next Metabase cards on dashboard 12: lost-sales estimate, forecast vs actual accuracy, KPI tiles.
